name: Assumption Life (Assumption Mutual Life Insurance Company / Assomption Vie)
ownership: Mutual (owned by participating policyholders); Moncton, NB. Subsidiaries: Louisbourg Investments 70%, Lavvi 52%, Atlantic Holdings (1987) 100%
regulator: FCNB (New Brunswick), which applies OSFI LICAT for solvency; OSFI guidelines followed (B-15 reporting)

metrics.note: Record; +13% y/y per Insurance Portal (2026-03-05). Consolidated incl. segregated funds.

metrics.metric: Invested assets (note 4, carrying value, incl. par and pass-through fund units)
metrics.note: Of which investment fund units 379.6 (returns passed to UL policyholders) and 67.3 matched to participating contracts; debt securities 556.0, mortgages 181.7, preferred shares 79.7, cash 50.0. AR 2025 note 4.
AR 2025 fair-value hierarchy table (990.7 in 2024). Seg fund investment contract liabilities 639.8, insurance contract liabilities 475.0.

Up from 2.8bn in 2024; 'strongest year of growth in its history' (AR 2025 p.20). Website shows '+3,3 G$' undated (https://www.louisbourg.com/fr-ca/). Includes Assumption/Louisbourg seg funds and third-party institutional/private wealth.
FY2025 vs 146.9 FY2024. Insurance service result 16.5 (14.0).
+26% y/y; net premiums 450.3. Company highlights cite 'C$577mm premiums and deposits' (non-IFRS, unaudited).
FY2025 profit 13.065 (11.836 in 2024); attributable to policyholders 12.006 (12.592), down 5%; NCI 1.059. No core/underlying earnings measure published. No interim reporting (annual only).
165% in 2024. Available capital 398.7mm, required capital 238.7mm (AR note 26). Supervisory target 100%; internal target not disclosed. Core ratio not disclosed.
No debt capital; only lease liabilities (interest 0.176mm). Leverage effectively nil (inferred from FS).
Held 26 consecutive years per company. Not rated by S&P/Moody's/DBRS/Fitch (none found).

Counts all Louisbourg staff on website: 7 portfolio managers + Directeur des placements + ~6 investment assistants/portfolio accountants; rest client service/ops. In-house insurer investment staff not disclosed.
Incl. students/temporary; recruiting 22 more in 2026. Group incl. Louisbourg and Lavvi per AR staff list.

metrics.metric: Key management compensation (all directors + executives, aggregate)
metrics.note: AR note 27: salaries/short-term 4.443 + pension 0.200. Individual pay not disclosed (mutual, no proxy circular).

business_mix.basis: IFRS 17 insurance revenue by line, FY2025 (total C$159.7mm). Excludes investment-contract (seg fund/RIA) fee revenue reported in other operating revenue (C$17.5mm).
business_mix.note: Sales mix FY2025 (Insurance Portal): individual insurance C$16.6mm (+22%), group C$7.4mm (+4%), investments & retirement C$400.5mm (+26%). Liability mix: annuities/pensions C$939.6mm and individual insurance C$533.2mm of insurance contract liabilities incl. seg fund-backed.

pm_structure.summary: Who manages the C$0.8bn non-par general account is not disclosed. Investment and mortgage credit policies set limits in-house; 70%-owned Louisbourg Investments (C$3.1bn AUM) runs the Assumption/Louisbourg seg funds and third-party mandates; other seg funds sub-advised by CI, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton and ETF-based portfolios.
manager_entities: Louisbourg Investments Inc. (70% owned, Dieppe NB; offices Moncton, Halifax, Québec, Montréal, Vancouver)
bullets: No CIO at the insurer; FS note 5 says credit risk is run 'through the Group's investment policy' with limits by geography, issuer type, rating, maturity
Louisbourg (est. 1991, 28 staff, 7 PMs) grew AUM 2.8bn to 3.1bn in 2025; five strategies top-quartile in RBC Pooled Fund Survey
Seg fund shelf: Assumption/Louisbourg funds plus Assumption/CI, Fidelity and Templeton sub-advised funds (seg fund FS, 2025)
Mortgage book (C$182mm) underwritten in-house under a specific credit policy; commercial, insured and other residential
Lavvi (52%) is the group's insurtech platform subsidiary, not an asset manager

rotation_commentary.text: No portfolio-repositioning narrative in AR 2025; commentary is on seg-fund fee cuts, Louisbourg AUM growth and a 2026-2030 strategic plan ('human, simple, accessible').
Note 4 shows a surplus-style book: C$87.7mm government bonds and C$25.0mm insured mortgages at amortized cost; C$64.6mm preferred shares designated FVOCI (no recycling).
CEO: growth 'put pressure on operations'; 2026 spend goes to admin-system upgrades for individual and group platforms, partners to be chosen in 2026 (no asset-mix guidance).

securities_lending.text: No securities lending disclosed in AR 2025 notes.

repos.text: No repurchase / reverse repurchase agreements disclosed; liquidity note only says credit lines are available if needed.

structured_indirect.text: No CLO/ABS/fund-finance exposure disclosed. Debt securities are government (C$445mm) and corporate (C$111mm); mortgages C$182mm direct. Investment fund units C$380mm are UL pass-through.
Contingent commitment: Assumption has agreed to provide Assuris a credit facility drawable on demand (amount not stated).

leverage.note: No debt, LRCNs or preferred shares; borrowing costs C$0.18mm are lease interest. Undisbursed approved mortgages C$7.1mm (1-6 months).

deals.text: Goose Insurance partnership (Sep 2025): whole life and renewable term sold in Goose's app; Assumption is the carrier (Pierre Martin, Chief Digital Officer, quoted).
Louisbourg Investments referral arrangements with PPI and New Outlook Wealth to grow private wealth distribution.
UV Insurance distributes Assumption Life's segregated funds and registered investment accounts Canada-wide (effective 2021-09-15); Assumption remains insurer.
Lavvi (52% subsidiary) deployed its digital platform at Assumption Life and signed carrier partners; 'strongest financial performance to date'.

sponsorships.text: Presenting sponsor (2nd year) of NB Ride Against Cancer: C$275k raised for Wellspring NB, Friends of The Moncton Hospital Foundation, CHU Dumont Foundation.
Annual Assumption Life golf tournament since 2001 for Atlantic Cancer Research Institute; C$2mm+ raised since inception.
B Corp certified; 160+ community projects, 3,100+ employee volunteer hours; first SmileZone in NB at The Moncton Hospital.

bank_relationships.text: No bank distribution or dealer relationships disclosed; distribution is via independent advisors/MGAs (PPI referral deal for Louisbourg). No capital-markets issuance, so no bookrunners.

appetite: Board approves risk appetites; investment policy sets limits by geography, issuer type, average rating and maturity
Mortgage credit policy: industry limits, excluded sectors, single-borrower caps, collateral required
Reinsurers must carry minimum A- financial strength rating (compliant at YE2025)
governance: Board oversight via Audit Committee (also oversees climate risk); no separate board risk committee disclosed
CRO Isabelle Bourgeois also Chief of Internal Audit; Executive Committee and Climate Risk Governance Committee (chaired by CFO)
Annual Financial Condition Testing (FCT) by valuation actuary, presented to Board and filed with FCNB
risk.capital_target: Supervisory target total ratio 100% (FCNB aligned with OSFI); actual 167% at YE2025 = capacity to absorb ~C$160mm of adverse results. Internal target not disclosed.
sensitivities: Rates -50bp: profit -C$0.5mm, equity +C$3.6mm, CSM -C$0.2mm; +50bp: profit +C$0.06mm, equity -C$3.7mm (2025, C$000 in AR)
Corporate spreads +50bp: profit +C$1.8mm, equity -C$1.9mm; provincial spreads +50bp: profit -C$1.3mm, equity -C$3.7mm, CSM -C$0.4mm
Equities -10%: no profit/equity impact, CSM -C$4.7mm (seg fund & equity exposure absorbed in CSM); +10%: CSM +C$4.3mm
Mortality +2% (life): CSM -C$8.8mm gross / -C$2.4mm net of reinsurance; profit -C$1.8mm gross / -C$0.6mm net
hedging: No derivative or seg-fund dynamic hedging program disclosed; seg fund guarantee risk managed via investment policy limits and reinsurance
Heavy use of reinsurance: allocation of reinsurance premiums C$41.8mm vs insurance revenue C$159.7mm (2025)
events: No regulatory actions or risk events disclosed; profit to policyholders -5% in 2025 on strategic-plan investment spend

gaps: General-account manager not disclosed: neither the AR, the B-15 report nor Louisbourg's site says who manages the insurer's own bonds/mortgages (in-house vs Louisbourg).
No CIO or head of investments at the insurer; org chart below CEO for investments is unknown.
Mutual: no proxy circular, so no individual compensation; only aggregate key-management comp (C$4.6mm, 2025).
Bios (year joined, prior firms) for CFO Michel Allain, CRO Isabelle Bourgeois and Louisbourg's Luc Gaudet/Mathieu Roy not found before the search budget ran out.
Core LICAT ratio, internal capital target range and ORSA details not disclosed.
No interim (quarterly) financials; FY2025 is the latest.
Consolidated statement of financial position did not extract from the PDF text layer; total assets taken from highlights/press (C$2.6bn).
No disclosed target asset allocation or repositioning narrative.
notes: Assumption Life is a C$2.6bn-asset NB mutual whose balance sheet is dominated by segregated funds (C$1.1bn) and UL pass-through fund units (C$0.38bn); the non-par general account is roughly C$0.8bn (government bonds 50%, mortgages 22%, corporates 13%, preferreds 8%). Economics are driven by fee income on investments & retirement sales (C$400mm in 2025) and heavy reinsurance of individual life. The group's asset-management capability sits in 70%-owned Louisbourg Investments (C$3.1bn AUM, Luc Gaudet CEO, Mathieu Roy head of investments), whose role on the general account is not disclosed. Personal library not available in this session; public sources used. WebSearch budget was exhausted near the end of the task, so a few bio lookups (Allain, Bourgeois, Gaudet) were not completed.
